Complete means the declared range was captured. Partial results, unread ranges, and issues include reasons. Authentication-protected or proprietary data may not be readable.
Save text or JSON to a location you choose, or select an app from Android's share sheet. Check how the selected destination handles the data.
The app reads tags only; it does not write to tags or bypass authentication. Dumps may contain identifiers or sensitive information. Read only tags you are authorized to inspect.

NFCReader, developed by Atsumi3, reads information exposed by Android from NFC tags and displays it on your device. A dump may include tag IDs, technology details, raw responses, decoded data, coverage, and errors.
The app has no advertising or analytics SDK and no account feature. It does not send data to a developer server. Tag data is processed on your device while reading.

Read results are held in memory while displayed and are not saved as reading history. The app temporarily uses its private cache to prepare saves and shares. Share cache files are not guaranteed to be deleted immediately and may remain until Android clears the cache. You can clear NFCReader's cache in Android settings. App backup is disabled.

Files are written to a location you choose. Sharing grants the selected app read access to a file. Copied values may remain in the device clipboard. The app marks clips as sensitive where supported, but cannot control storage or transmission by other apps.

The app has no account or saved reading history. Clear its private cache in Android Settings > Apps > NFCReader > Storage. Delete exported files at their destination. Replace or clear clipboard contents using your device's controls.
Contact us through public GitHub Issues. Issues are public; do not post NFC dumps, card numbers, identifiers, or other personal data.
Hold a tag near your device's NFC antenna. Reading is read-only, and data is processed on this device.
Turn on NFC in your device settings to read tags.
Hold the tag near your device and keep it still while trying again.
Keep the tag close to your device until reading finishes.
